0048 is a July 2025 invoice — excluded. My enumeration is complete.

### Caveats worth noting
- **Duplicate invoice numbers.** Several distinct invoices reuse the same number — e.g., INV-2025-00847 appears on four different Initech invoices (Feb 2, Feb 13, Feb 22 ×2), each with different line items and totals; GS-2025-04817 and GS-2025-04417 each appear on two separate Globex invoices. These are separate documents, not duplicates of one another, so I listed each individually. The numbers alone will not uniquely identify these invoices in AP.
- **Vendor-detail inconsistencies.** Addresses, Tax IDs, and bank details vary across invoices from the same vendor (e.g., Globex lists Tax IDs 47-3829104, 47-3821056, 47-3821905, 31-4478821). Marbledock's own bill-to address also varies (Boston, Portland ME/OR, Seattle).
- **Excluded near-misses:** invoices *due* in February but issued in January — `0056` (GS-2025-04417, Jan 17), `0050` (GS-2025-00847, Jan 3), `0052` (INV-2025-00847, Jan 13), `0026` (CDI-2025-04817, Jan 22), `0031` (INV-2025-00847, Jan 20), `0055` (CDI-2025-00847, Jan 19) — were not included since they weren't *issued* in February.
- `0046_invoice` is an OCR'd PDF (≈91% confidence); its total ($18,797.67) reconciles arithmetically with the listed subtotal, discount, and tax, so I'm confident in it.
